_comment: Character consistency with ref2va. Reference media is addressed in the prompt by 1-based ordinal per type: <Picture 1>..<Picture 9>, <Video 1>..<Video 3>, <Audio 1>..<Audio 3>. Paths are relative to where you run h3-batch.py. Get a character still out of an existing clip with scripts/extract-ref.py.

jobs.name: family-livingroom
jobs.prompt:
<Picture 1> The exact same cartoon family from the reference image, same faces, same hair, same clothes: the lanky redheaded dad with round glasses and a mustard cardigan, the mom with a short teal bob and green dress, the freckled kid with wild orange curls. Now crowded onto a sagging plaid sofa in their wood-panelled living room, watching a boxy television that lights their faces.

Timeline:
[0s-2s] The three of them stare slack-jawed at the TV, its glow flickering across their faces.
[2s-4s] The kid slowly reaches for the last snack in a bowl without looking away from the screen.
[4s-5.2s] Dad's hand arrives at the empty bowl, he looks down, then deadpan straight at camera.

1990s American animated sitcom, flat cel-shaded 2D cartoon, bold black outlines, saturated primary colors, grainy broadcast look. Locked-off camera, cartoon physics, exaggerated expressions.

Audio: muffled television chatter, a laugh track swelling at 4.5s, the hollow scrape of an empty snack bowl at 4s.

jobs.name: family-driveway
jobs.prompt:
<Picture 1> The same cartoon family from the reference, unchanged in face and wardrobe, now standing in a suburban driveway beside a boxy station wagon packed to the roof with luggage.

Timeline:
[0s-2s] Dad slaps the roof of the wagon with proud confidence.
[2s-3.5s] A single suitcase slides off the far side and bursts open off-screen.
[3.5s-5.2s] Mom closes her eyes, the kid points and cackles, dad's smile holds far too long.

1990s American animated sitcom, flat cel-shaded 2D cartoon, bold black outlines, saturated primary colors. Static wide shot, cartoon physics.

Audio: cheerful suburban morning birds, a hollow metallic slap at 0.5s, an off-screen clatter at 2.5s, canned laughter at 4s.
